title: What is the difference between CLO and Marvelous Designer?
content: **Question** What is the difference between CLO and Marvelous Designer? **Answer** Although the core technology behind the solutions are the same, Marvelous Designer is primarily used in the CG, animation, and gaming industries. CLO is a more robust solution geared towards the fashion and apparel industries with functions that can be applied to various stages of the garment design development process. The primary difference between the two solutions is that the import/export of DXF-AAMA or DXF-ASTM files in CLO, allows for production-ready patterns to be sent to your manufacturer.
content_description: This webpage clarifies the distinctions between CLO and Marvelous Designer, highlighting their specific applications in the fashion and gaming industries and the unique features that cater to each sector's needs.

title: Remove Device from CLO website
content: Applicable for: **7.2 and later** CLO product type: **StandAlone Onlineauth only** This forcibly ends the CLO license session on a previous device after a crash or unexpected shutdown. This allows you to activate and use the license on your current device. It's a recovery tool, not a remote logout. It only works when CLO has closed unexpectedly on the other device (e.g., termination due to software crash, sudden power off, etc.). It will not work if CLO is still running on the other device. It may take up to 15 minutes to remove the device. If you still can't login to CLO after this time, please contact support. Also Remove Device does not cancel your trial license and paid subscription. How to Remove Device 1) Log in to the CLO website. <https://www.clo3d.com/> 2) Select the profile icon at the top right and then select "[Subscription](https://www.clo3d.com/en/accounts/subscription)". 3) Click the "Remove Device" button. 4) Try logging into CLO software on a new device.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide to forcibly end a CLO license session on a previous device after an unexpected shutdown, allowing users to activate their license on a new device.

title: CLO Alumni Discount: Supporting Your Transition to the Professional World
content: Congratulations on your graduation! To support the next generation of designers, **CLO offers a special 50% discount for recent graduates.** This initiative aims to help you bridge the gap between your studies and your professional career by providing affordable access to our software. **What is the Alumni Discount?** Eligible graduates can receive **50% off** on both monthly and annual subscriptions. * **Duration:** Valid for one full year. * **Automatic Renewal:** After 12 months, your subscription will renew at the regular price unless canceled. ⚠️ Important: This discount is not compatible with active Student Subscriptions. You must wait for your student license to expire before applying. **Eligibility & Required Documentation** To qualify for this program, you must have been enrolled as a full-time student at an accredited university or school. Your graduation date must be within the **last six months.** You are required to provide one of the following official documents to verify your status: * **University Degree or Official Certificate:** This document must include your full name, the name of the institution, the date of completion, and the official signature/seal of the university. * **Official Graduation Letter:** A formal letter from your university confirming the successful completion of your program. **Note:** You must have a registered individual CLO account before applying. The coupon can be applied to new subscriptions or the next billing cycle of an existing one. **Application Steps** Follow these steps to request your discount: 1. **Prepare your files:** Ensure your proof of graduation is in a digital format (PDF or high-quality image). 2. **Submit a request:** Visit our **Contact Us** page and submit your request through the [**General Support** section](https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus/general). 3. **Include Required Details** : In your message, you must: 1. Attach your official graduation documentation. 2. Provide the email address associated with your CLO account. 3. Specify if you prefer the Monthly or Annual plan 4. **Wait for verification:** Our team will review your documentation. Once approved, you will receive a response directly within your support ticket containing the specific steps to follow to get your discount. **Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)** **Can I apply if I graduated more than six months ago?** Unfortunately, no. This specific program is designed for very recent graduates. Your graduation or completion date must be within the six-month window prior to your application. **What happens if I cancel my subscription mid-year?** * **Monthly Plan:** The discount is tied to an active, continuous subscription. If you cancel it, you will immediately lose the 50% benefit and you will not be able to reactivate it for the remainder of that year. * **Annual Plan:** If you cancel the auto-renewal of your annual license, you will still enjoy the access you paid for until the end of the 12-month period, but the license will not renew for the following year. **Does the discount apply to both Monthly and Annual plans?** Yes. You can choose the plan that best fits your needs. The 50% reduction applies to the total price of the Annual plan or to each of the 12 monthly payments of the Monthly plan. **Can I use this discount if I already have an active subscription?** Yes, if you are already an Individual subscriber, the discount will be applied to your next billing cycle once verified. However, please note that this discount cannot be applied to active Student Subscriptions. If you are a student, you must wait for your current license to expire before applying for the Alumni Discount. **What happens after the one-year discount period ends?** Once the 12-month discount period is over, your subscription will automatically renew at the regular price unless you choose to cancel it before the renewal date.
content_description: Unlock your creative potential with CLO's exclusive 50% Alumni Discount for recent graduates, designed to provide affordable access to our software as you transition from academia to your professional career.

title: Disk access rights required when CLO is running
content: In order for the CLO to operate normally, sufficient read and write permissions are required on the disk in the user's computer. This 'read and write rights' must apply to all storage devices in the user's computer, including hard disk and SSD. Usually, this task is done in the same way as installing with admin rights and running with admin rights, and through this way, various unexpected errors also can be prevented. **Please note** that this may require assistance from the administrator of your computer, i.e. your IT or security team. **Common problematic situations** * File write error occurs while installing CLO software. * Unable to launch CLO, it is not responding. * Able to run CLO, but not responding when using certain functions. * Installed CLO, but there are no default asset files like avatars and garments. * Unable to save files to specific folders or directories. * Not responding or crashes when loading or saving certain files. * A warning window "You don't have permission to download" appears. ![001_Windows.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/17078066098201) * * * **Windows** 1 After logging in to Windows with the Windows administrator profile, install the CLO with administrator privileges. Click Run as administrator and a Windows User Account Control pop-up will appear. Select Yes. ![007_Run_as_Administrator.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/27790394854297) * If your school or company security policy requires you to log in to Windows with guest privileges rather than administrator privileges, go to step 2 below. 2 After exiting the CLO software, go to the path where the CLO is installed. 3 Right-click the CLO executable file, select Properties, and select Users from the Security tab. 4 Click Edit and change the permissions as shown in the picture. Read & execute, Read, Write items must be selected. 5 When you're done applying permissions, choose Apply. ![002_Windows.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/17078067715225) * * * **macOS** 1 Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access. 2 Click + icon at the bottom of the window, click the CLO from Applications, and Open it. 3 Click the CLO app and enable toggle switch. ![CLO_Full_Disk_Access.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/21306070478233)
content_description: This webpage provides essential instructions for ensuring proper read and write permissions on your computer to facilitate the normal operation of CLO software and prevent common errors.

title: Seamless Blocking
content: ## **New in 2025.1** **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48549969578265)** #### **Create/Edit** **Set Fabric** **** The ability to section off patterns to add in different fabrics or textures without cutting the pattern.__ **** #### **Create/Edit** 1. Within the 2D toolbar under Internal polygon tool, click ![Seaming Line On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48632682493721) **Seamless Blocking** tool. 2. Single Click on a pattern outline to start the creation process of a seamless blocking line or seamless line. 3. Create or Edit the Seamless Blocking line referring to below table. **Tool** | **Action** | **Outcome** ---|---|--- ![Seaming.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48549969581977) **Seamless Blocking** | **Clicking once on a pattern outline** | This will start the creation process of a seamless blocking line or seamless line. You can create any type of shape with as many points as you would like, through single clicks within a pattern piece. The Symmetry rules will be followed when creating the lines. With half symmetry when creating a line that goes over the half symmetrical line then it will not be replicated on the other side. Close shapes are the only creation that can be made using this tool. **Double Clicking on a pattern outline** | This will end the shape / creation process. As long as you finish on a pattern outline or another seamless block line **Holding down Ctrl** | While creating a line if you hold down Ctrl curve points will be created **Holding down Shift** | While creating a seamless line if you hold down Shift this will give you 45 Degree angles for guidance **Selecting Backspace/ Delete** | While creating the lines if you select the back space this will delete the last created point ![Edit Pattern.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48549969583001) **Edit Pattern** | **Selecting Seamless Blocked Line/ Point** **(**_**Single Left Click)**_ | Once the lines are created you can use the Edit pattern curve to edit the line or point. Click and dragging will move the line or point While dragging if you simultaneously right click a precision box will come up and you can edit the line using exact measurements Selecting the line using the edit pattern tool you can also delete the line or point as well. **Right Click on Pattern Outline or Seamless Line** | You can create more seamless blocked lines with the offset as seamless block line. From there you will be able to choose how many offset you would want to create, along with the distance that they should all be. Since closed shapes must always be created, the extend option will always be selected. **Editing Pattern line or Point** | when adjusting the pattern outline or point the seamless blocked lines will follow along with the pattern outline adjustments ![Transform Pattern.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48555563497113) **Transform Pattern** | **Dragging Point or Line** | The seamless block lines will follow the adjustments that are made to the whole pattern. It will follow based on proportion. ![Trace.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48549913094681) **Trace** | **Right Click on a Internal or Base line.** | There will be an option to convert to seamless block line. If the line/shape does not create a closed shape then CLO will not convert the internal line or base line into a seamless line. #### **Set Fabric** Fabric can be added to different seamless blocked sections through dragging and dropping the fabric from the object browser onto the seamless block area in either the 3D or 2D window. **📝Note:** _The assigning option within the object browser will not work when seamless blocking is applied_ Symmetry will not be followed when applying fabric with seamless blocking to allow for more creative options. ![seamless block fabric.gif](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48555563495833) Using ![Transform Pattern On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48634465212313)**Transform Pattern** tool , you will be able to select the seamless block section by double clicking. From there you will be able to see the fabric within use, within your property editor under the fabric section ![Screenshot 2025-07-03 231547.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48555563498777) Properties that will apply to the entire pattern: * Information * Bond/Skive * Geometry * Arrangement * * * #### **📝Note:** * [**Graphic**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000483967-Apply-Graphic-Image) The seamless blocking lines will not interfere with any placement of the graphics, it will be applied as if there aren't any lines. * [**Topstitch**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002224507--Tool-Segment-Topstitch)** & **[**Puckering**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002227447--Tool-Segment-Puckering) These can be applied to seamless blocked lines as if they are internal lines using the Topstitch or Puckering tools to apply and edit onto the lines. * [**Print Layout**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000565568-Nest-Patterns) If seamless blocking is applied to the patterns it will be excluded from the print layout window. * **Compatibility with Older Versions** If opening up a seamless block file within a CLO version below 2025.1 the seamless blocked lines will reflect as baselines.
content_description: Discover the new Seamless Blocking feature in version 2025.1 that allows you to creatively section patterns for fabric application without cutting, enhancing your design flexibility in CLO.

content:
**List of Contents** Edit Grading Edit Notch Grading Set Options Irregular Grading ## Edit the grading size applied to the Pattern. [![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45452655620633) Watch the tutorial video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nVO7HTQKxdg) **** #### **Edit Grading** 1. When the All value is changed, the offset between all sizes is applied equally to the corresponding value. Compare size differences more easily by floating the Grading table! 1. Click on the pattern outline or point with ![Edit Grading On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45452655621657)Edit Grading tool. 2. Click ![Edit Grading On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45452655621657) **Edit Grading** in the 2D toolbar. 2. Select a notch in the 2D Window. _**✨Tip:** To select multiple notches to edit, press the Shift key and click the notches; or click and drag to draw a selection box in the background._ 3. In Property Editor, set the notch grading information. Changes to Notch Distance are instantly applied to the 2D patterns and 3D garment. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Grading Distance** | ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/59737571217945) Decide the notch's grading mode and set the notch distance. **Ratio** | The notch starting position is moved proportionally on each size grading. **Fixed** **(**[**![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/59737571233817)Watch Video**](https://youtu.be/CwB8_ad328M?si=FG3gZ82C3FAw-ayR&t=2109)**)** | Instead of moving the notches proportionally with the grading size, it fixes them in a specific position. It can be set when importing [DXF](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000493067-2D-Pattern-DXF-Import-Export) files. **Fixed Start Point** | All notches’ starting points are fixed based on the first size. **Reverse Direction** | Keep the default notch moving direction or to reverse it. **Distance Chart** | The chart shows all the size sets. When inputting the distance value in the chart, notches move according to the pattern outline. **📝Note:** * _The selected Base Size is displayed as a 0 value and cannot be changed._ * _When enabling**Fixed** Grading Distance mode, users won't be able to input a custom distance._
_**✨Tip:** Both positive & negative number are supported. When using a negative number, the moving direction will be reversed. _ 4. Sewing lines and graded notches are automatically synced across all size sets to maintain garment fitting accuracy. **** #### **Set Options** 1. Right-click on the pattern outline and point. 2. Click the menu as needed. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Convert to Grade/Non-Grade Point** [**![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/50833016170905)Watch Video**](https://youtu.be/E83Ye7DZO1s?si=aU_o9zUC2ybi4BuL) | Now you have a regular segment point/curve point, which you can convert to Grade/ Non-Grade points. Only the defined Grade Point follows the grading rule. All the other Points or Non-Grade Points follow the Grade Point movement proportionately. All the Grade Points are represented with a Green Halo & Non-Grade points are just regular points. ![image \(1\).png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48717464761497) **Remove Graded size** | The grading applied to the selected pattern is removed. **Copy** | Copy the grading value of the selected point. **Paste/ Mirror Paste** | Paste the copied grading values as they are, or paste only the values of the X or Y axis. **Flip Horizontally /Vertically** | The grading applied to the selected segment is flipped horizontally/vertically. **Align** | Rearrange grading by Pattern/Segment/Point. **📝 Note:** You can also align by internal lines and graphics. **** ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55511863825561) #### **Irregular Grading** Streamline the grading process by allowing multiple fields within the grading table to be edited at once, ensuring uniform changes across different sizes or axes. 1. Use the![Edit Grading On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45452655621657) **Edit Grading** tool to select the point or segment you want to adjust. 2. In the Property Editor's grading table, use the following shortcuts to highlight multiple input fields: * **Continuous Selection** : Click a field, hold **Shift** , and click another field to select all cells in between. * **Random/Specific Selection** : Hold **Ctrl (Cmd)** and click individual fields to select specific, non-adjacent cells. * **Drag Selection:** Click and drag the mouse across multiple cells to highlight continuous fields. 3. While holding **Shift** or **Ctrl (Cmd)** , double-click the last selected field to activate the input box for the entire selection. 4. Type a value into the active cell and press **Enter**. 5. The entered value is applied to every selected field instantly. **📝 Note:** This behavior applies to any editable numeric field within the size-specific rows of the grading table. _**✨**_**Tip:** Use mathematical operators (e.g., *2 or +5) to perform relative calculations across all selected fields at once. **** Go back to the List of Contents

title: Custom Measurements
content: **New in 2026.0** **Add Custom Measurements** **Adjust Placement** **** Precisely measure and set the placement of a graphic by measuring from specific anchor points on the graphic to the Pattern Outline. #### **Add Custom Measurements** **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55409872795545)** **Straight line Custom Measurements** 1. Select the **Transform Graphic** tool from the 2D toolbar. 2. **Right-click** the graphic in the 2D window and select **Custom Measurements.** 3. Click the Pattern Outline directly within the horizontal or vertical range of the graphic to automatically create a straight-line measurement. **Lock to** | **Graphic Outline** (default) | Tethers the measurement anchor primarily to the **Graphic Outline**. The measurement anchor point follows the graphic's transformations; if the graphic is scaled or moved, the measurement persists relative to the artwork's edges. ---|---|--- **Pattern Outline** | Tethers the measurement anchor primarily to the **Pattern Outline**. The anchor point remains fixed on the pattern; moving the graphic manually will update the measurement distance while the pattern anchor stays in its original static position. #### **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55409872795545)** **X &Y Measurement Coordinates** 1. Select the **Transform Graphic** tool from the 2D toolbar. 2. **Right-click** the graphic in the 2D window and select **Custom Measurements**. 3. Select the starting point **on the graphic** : * **Free Selection** : Click anywhere within the graphic area. * **Snap Selection** : Hold the **Shift** key to display the graphic’s bounding box corners, center, and midpoints. The system also provides point recommendations based on the graphic image itself. * The cursor will automatically snap to the nearest recommended point for easier selection. 4. Move the cursor and click on the target **Pattern Outline/Point** to establish the measurement. #### #### **Adjusting Placement** 1. Once the measurement is established, use the **Placement** Input Box in the Property Editor for exact coordinate control: **X & Y** | Enter specific values to define the distance between the pattern outline (or point) and the anchor point on the graphic. ---|--- **Graphic Movement** | Confirming these values moves the entire graphic to the precise coordinates relative to the pattern. **Instant Sync** | The graphic position updates immediately in both 2D and 3D windows. **📝 Note:** * **Smart Snapping** When holding **Shift** , the recommended points are dynamically generated based on the graphic’s visual style and geometry, allowing for more intuitive placement relative to the artwork's design. _**✨**_**Tips:** * **Direct Calculation** Instead of calculating the final distance manually, you can type basic equations (e.g., `50 + 15` or `100 / 2`) into the X or Y input fields. * **Relative Adjustments** This allows you to shift the graphic by a specific increment relative to its current measured distance without clearing the existing value. * **Efficiency** The software will automatically solve the equation and move the entire graphic to the resulting coordinate immediately.
content_description: Discover how to enhance your graphic precision with the new 2026.0 features for adding and adjusting custom measurements, enabling exact placement from anchor points to pattern outlines.

title: Express Denim Wet Wash
content: **New in 2025.1** Apply Wet Process Presets Wash Parameters **** Express Denim wet wash effects without using external software and avoid many back-and-forth steps. YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e-LWjUgZG_o&list=PLqL8Ymi3Z68ABUsNwipS2n8rhAhBW6OBU&index=11 #### **Apply** 1. [Change the Material Type](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115015998728-Material-Type) to the**Denim.** → It is applied as unwashed by default. 2. Apply the denim texture as the [Base Color Map](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047317454-Set-Fabric-Materials#01J8J0B16SJ6HJCMDVGKG9XNFB). 3. Set the Denim Wet Wash type. → The wash effects are applied on the Fabric's Base Color Map. #### **Wet Process Presets** 1. **Unwashed:** The denim retains its raw, original state. It's typically stiff, dark, and may have a slightly rough texture. The color is a deep, uniform indigo with no fading or alteration. 2. **Rinse Wash:** The rinse wash gives denim a clean and slightly softened look. The fabric retains its original color, but with a more even tone and a softer feel. 3. **Enzyme Wash:** This wash results in a softer fabric and a slightly faded appearance. It provides a more broken-in feel without significant color loss. 4. **Stone Wash:** Stone washing creates a worn and faded appearance. The use of pumice stones produces a pronounced contrast between light and dark areas, giving the denim a distressed look. 5. **Acid Wash:** Acid wash creates a heavily contrasted, marbled effect. The denim has distinct light and dark splotches, resulting in a bold, aged look. 6. **Bleach Wash:** Bleach wash lightens the denim's color, ranging from subtle lightening to near-white, depending on the intensity and duration of the process. The fabric may show signs of distress and color variation. 7. **Ozone Wash:** Ozone wash fades the denim, resulting in a uniform and subtly lighter shade. This method reduces environmental impact and maintains fabric integrity. 8. **Custom Wash:** This option allows the application of custom maps, enabling the expression of unique and personalised visual effects. The appearance depends entirely on the user-defined maps & parameters, offering limitless possibilities. #### **Wash Parameters** 1. Adjust the wash parameters to express realistic wet wash effects. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Wash Map** | **Concentration/Intensity** | Set the wash effect intensity on the Base Color Map. **Transformation** | Scale, rotate or move the Wash Effect **Blend** | Plenty of Blending options are provided, which decide how the wash effect blends with the base Fabric. _* Overlay is recommended for the majority of Denim washes._ **Absorbency** | Adjust how deeply these effects need to be absorbed/spread in the Base Fabric. **Cycle Duration** | Sets the Cycle Duration/Washing Time. Longer duration removes more dye/color from the yarn (Base Color Map). **Seam Abrasion** | Enhance the Base Color Map of Puckering applied to the pattern with the respective Fabric.
content_description: Discover how to effortlessly apply realistic wet wash effects to denim using our new presets and parameters in 2025.1, eliminating the need for external software and streamlining your design process.

title: Graphics Card Problems and Troubleshooting
content: 1\. By updating the graphics card driver, you can solve and prevent graphics card-related problems that may occur while using the CLO software. 2\. Guides you on how to properly connect your desktop graphics card and monitor. ### Applicable for: All users of CLO software * * * ## Common Problems 1\. OpenGL version warning appears when running CLO software as shown in the figure below. ![001_CLO_error.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/11907102744473) 2\. Graphics/texture errors or rendering images appear strange while running CLO software. 3\. If the CLO GPU-simulation or GPU-rendering speed is lower than the expected performance of your computer's specifications. * * * ## How to Update Graphics Card Driver Step 1) Find out the product name of the graphics card (GPU) installed in your desktop computer or laptop. * As shown in the figure below, you can find the model name of your graphics card (GPU) in the Performance tab of Windows Task Manager. ![002_Task_Manager.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/11907339007001) Step 2) Search and download the latest driver matching the product name from each manufacturer's website. * Note that even if the graphics card model name looks the same or similar, the drivers for laptops and desktops, and for workstations and servers are different. Search for and install the driver for the type of computer you are using. * [AMD Radeon Driver Download (Link)](https://www.amd.com/en/support) * [Nvidia Driver Download (Link)](https://www.nvidia.com/Download/index.aspx?lang=en) * [Intel Graphics Driver Download (Link)](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/download-center/home.html) Step 3) Run the downloaded driver file. It is recommended to install with administrator privileges. * A computer reboot may be required after driver installation. Follow the on-screen instructions. ![003_RunAsAdministrator.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/11907829801369) * * * ## Connecting the monitor and graphics card correctly As shown in the figure below, if the monitor cable is connected to the integrated graphics (a.k.a., iGPU, internal GPU), the integrated graphics is mainly used instead of the discrete graphics (a.k.a., external GPU, dedicated GPU). In this case, you may encounter several issues while launching and working on the CLO software, including OpenGL version warnings. ![004_Connectors.JPG](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/11908381625497) **How to fix** Step 1) Save the files you are working on and turn off the computer completely. Step 2) Connect the monitor cable to the external graphics card and turn on the computer. Connect all monitor cables to the external graphics card, even when using more than one monitor. Step 3) If there is no screen output on the monitor, try reconnecting the monitor power. The pictures below show the discrete graphics card installed and cabled. ![007_desktop.jpg](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44942675738777) ![008_desktop.jpg](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44942668883481) **See also** * Supported monitor cable types vary depending on the graphic card and monitor. * If you are using the latest monitor and the latest graphic card, most support HDMI or DP (DisplayPort). * Find the right cable for your monitor and graphics card. [Saved search (Link)](https://www.google.com/search?q=monitor+cable+types&oq=monitor+cable) * * * ## Read more * CLO software automatically detects the graphics card and driver installed in the computer when launching, and displays a warning if an unsupported graphics card or outdated driver is found. Please refer to the guide above to solve the problem. * If you are using a laptop with an Nvidia graphics card, the laptop will have either an AMD processor or an Intel processor with integrated graphics GPU and Nvidia GPU, respectively, depending on the situation. If an openGL-related error appears while using the CLO software, select 'High-performance Nvidia processor' in the Nvidia control panel as shown below and click Apply. ![005_Nvidia_Control_Panel.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/11909209788825) * If you set Windows Update to 'Auto', it will automatically install the latest graphics card driver. However, the driver provided by the graphics card manufacturer's website is more up-to-date than the Windows update version. * It is recommended to update the graphics card driver at least once every 6 months. It helps with CLO software as well as all other graphics programs and overall system performance and stability. * To check GPU usage in Windows, select GPU in the Performance tab of Task Manager as shown below. ![006_CUDA.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/11909425727769) * If you are using a Mac, the graphics card driver is included in macOS. If you update to the latest macOS, the latest graphics card driver is also installed. * To check CPU-GPU usage on Mac, use the Activity Monitor app built-in to macOS. * Also check the [CLO system requirements](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000307168) for graphics card related information.
content_description: This web page provides essential guidance for CLO software users on updating graphics card drivers and properly connecting monitors to resolve common graphics-related issues.

title: What is CLO Verified?
content: ### CLO OFFICIAL VERIFICATION CLO Verified is not a training, but an assessment of your skills in CLO Available for any CLO user with an Active Individual or Student License. No Enterprise Licenses can be used The test is broken into 3 different parts 1. Build a garment from a DXF pattern. 2. Correct a built garment that needs to be fixed/edited [similar to what you would be tasked with working in the industry]. 3. Combine the 2 garments to create a full look which you will render in CLO. A Visual Quality Standards document will be sent the week before the test that will provide you with guidelines for the project submission. You will receive all tech packs, patterns, and necessary materials the day of the test for all 3 parts. Once completed, you will be notified 2-3 weeks after the test by email. You will receive both the outcome (Pass/Fail) and feedback about the files you have submitted. ### CERTIFICATE & BADGE All participants who pass the test will receive the CLO Verified Certificate, the only CLO recognized certificate, as well as the CLO Verified Badge which can be added to LinkedIn or other social media to show others their proven level of CLO expertise. ### PRACTICE ASSESSMENT We recommend all users take the self-graded Practice Test before signing up and paying for the Official Verification. This test is very similar but slightly shorter than the Official Verification and includes a Visual Quality Standards Guide to help you. Passing the CLO Verified Practice Test does not guarantee that you will pass the Official Verification, but it does mean that you should possess the skills needed to do so. Also, passing the practice test does not make you CLO Verified. To become CLO Verified you must take and Pass the Official Verification which the CLO Academic Team reviews and grades. ### ****CURRENTLY THE CLO VERIFIED PRACTICE & OFFICIAL VERIFICATION ARE ONLY AVAILABLE IN ENGLISH**** ### THINK YOU’RE READY? * Do you use CLO regularly [15+ hours a week] with a focus on the CLO garment construction workflow? * Are you able to quickly troubleshoot issues within CLO? * Are you comfortable with Tech-Packs and Visual Quality Standards? To sign up for CLO Verified Open Enrollment and/or take the Practice Assessment please head over to the CLO Academy [HERE](https://www.cloacademy.online/catalog)
content_description: The CLO Official Verification page provides a structured assessment for CLO users to validate their skills in garment construction, offering a recognized certification and feedback for successful participants.

title: Change Email from CLO-SET
content: ## **Objective** Understand how to change your email address, and the following implications of changing your account email. 1. Change Email vs. Email Switching 2. Ground Rules for Change Email 3. Change Email Guide * General Flow * Confirm License Info 4. [Change Email Implications](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/9876556955663-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#h_01J0QPN6FK48VSWVVB87JZJ82Y) 5. [Troubleshooting](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/9540709934223) ## **Details** #### **1) Change Email vs. Email Switching** **Change Email** | VS | **Email Switch** **(when the 'new email' is already on CLO-SET)** ---|---|--- ![change email.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49713825390873) | ![email switch.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49713825393817) * **Change Email** : Change your CLO-SET Integrated account email. Changing the CLO-SET email will also update the connected CLO license information if any. Please find instructions below on the Change Email Guide. * **Email Switch** : Email Switching is for users hoping to connect their existing CLO license with a different CLO-SET email account. This feature is not available yet. For such requests, please [submit a ticket](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new?ticket_form_id=9530590112143). #### **2) Ground Rules for Change Email** * Accounts registered as Enterprise or Academic on CLO software cannot use 'Change email' feature. * If the email address you want to change TO is already registered in CLO-SET, you cannot override an existing account. Please refer to the [troubleshooting guide](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/34340082505497-Troubleshooting-Email-Changes-on-CLO-SET) for further steps. * Your CONNECT account is the same as CLO-SET account. The two services share account information. #### **3) Change Email Guide** 1\. Click on the 'Change Email from CLO-SET' button on Account page and visit 'My page' on CLO-SET to start the change email process. ![image \(185\).png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49713838778521) 2\. If your CLO-SET account is also active on CLO service, please note that the account information on respective services will also be updated. Click 'OK' to proceed. ![image \(186\).png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49713825398681) 3\. On the following screen, please type in the new email address to be used. Click 'Send' to receive an email with the verification code. [Not receiving verification emails?](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/9021987313039-Not-receiving-verification-email) 4\. Once the verification is complete, you will see the final modal on the right. Please go back to the sign-in page, and start signing in with the new email address. Please also carefully read the implications of changing your emails. ![image \(187\).png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49713838791449)![image \(188\).png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49713825407897) 5\. **[Important]** Active License found under your New Email Address If the there is/are active CLO license under the 'new email' you typed in, your CLO-SET account will now be integrated with those License information. One of the two modals below will be displayed with the list of Licenses to be connected. ![image \(191\).png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49713825411353)![image \(192\).png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49713825413785) *Signing again with your current email ([abc@clo3d.com](mailto:abc@clo3d.com)) will create a 2nd CLO-SET account after changing your account email to [newemail@clo3d.com](mailto:newemail@clo3d.com). *If you would like to keep the license under the current email ([abc@clo3d.com](mailto:abc@clo3d.com)), please use the '[Email Switching](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/9876556955663-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#h_01J0QNCTQSZMYFJFQ43ZPVV7T3)' feature instead. #### **4) Change Email Implications** * **Impact on Request and Community History** Changing your email address will disconnect the history of your requests and community activities. This includes comments, request history, and other related data, which will no longer be associated with your new email address. * **Account Type** Enterprise user email changes are not allowed. Please make the change through your Company ID. It is possible to change your personal email to a corporate email, but the account type will not change. If you wish to change your account type from personal to enterprise, please contact our support team. * **Billing Email Matching** If your billing email matches your CLO-SET account email, it will automatically update when you change your CLO-SET email. However, if they don't match, your billing email will remain unchanged. * **Plan Type Considerations** If you have an active license and changing your email address affects your plan type (e.g., student to individual or vice versa), you won't be able to proceed with the email change. You may need to retain your current email or consider cancelling your subscription to initiate the change. If you don't have an active license and changing your email address affects your plan type (e.g., student to individual or vice versa), your user type will automatically change with the email change. (Individual↔️Student) However, be aware that this may impact the available subscription plans. Only plans corresponding to your updated user type will be available for purchase. * **Change Email between CLO global and China Websites** When you change your email on the CLO Global website, you cannot change it to the email registered on the CLO China website. **5) Troubleshooting** For various reasons, email changing is not supported systematically for certain accounts. Please follow the [Troubleshooting Guide](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/34340082505497-Troubleshooting-Email-Changes-on-CLO-SET) to reach the support team. * * * Before changing your email address in CLO-SET, please consider these factors to ensure a smooth transition and avoid any unexpected issues. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to [Contact Us](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).
content_description: This webpage aims to provide a comprehensive guide on how to change your email address on CLO-SET, including important considerations and potential implications of the change.
